name: Acoustic Guitar
description: Warm strummed chords and fingerpicked melodies. A versatile companion for singing and songwriting.

name: Classical Guitar
description: Gentle nylon strings and a rounded tone, ideal for fingerstyle playing and expressive solo pieces.

name: Electric Guitar
description: Shape your own sound, from clean melodies to bold riffs. An amplifier or headphone setup is needed.

name: Bass Guitar
description: Build the groove with deep, rhythmic bass lines. Great for players who love supporting a band.

name: Soprano Ukulele
description: A small four-string instrument with a bright voice and approachable first chords.

name: Tenor Ukulele
description: A little more room for your fingers and a fuller sound than a soprano ukulele.

name: Violin
description: A soaring, expressive voice for melodies. Bow control and accurate pitch reward regular practice.

name: Viola
description: A mellow middle voice with rich lower tones for ensemble players and lyrical soloists.

name: Cello
description: Deep, singing tones played while seated. A rewarding choice for patient melody lovers.

name: Double Bass
description: A resonant low voice that anchors an ensemble, played with a bow or plucked fingers.

name: Mandolin
description: Crisp paired strings bring sparkling melodies and rhythmic chops to acoustic music.

name: Banjo
description: A lively, percussive twang for rolling fingerpicking and traditional dance tunes.

name: Lever Harp
description: Flowing, bell-like strings for peaceful melodies and harmonies. Larger models need space.

name: Lap Steel Guitar
description: Slide a steel bar across the strings for smooth, singing notes while playing seated.

name: Dulcimer
description: A lap-held mountain dulcimer with a gentle drone and an approachable melody layout.

name: Oud
description: A fretless, rounded lute for intricate melodies and expressive pitch inflections.

name: Sitar
description: Resonant sympathetic strings and bending notes create a distinctive, shimmering sound.

name: Erhu
description: Two bowed strings with a vocal quality. Sensitive bowing and pitch control shape each phrase.

name: Digital Piano
description: Weighted keys and headphone practice make this a flexible way to learn piano at home.

name: Acoustic Piano
description: A rich acoustic sound and responsive touch, with space and regular tuning to consider.

name: Portable Keyboard
description: Light keys, built-in sounds, and rhythms offer an accessible introduction to making music.

name: Synthesizer
description: Explore keys and sound design, creating your own textures, basses, and leads.

name: Accordion
description: Melody, bass, and chords in one instrument, powered by the movement of the bellows.

name: Melodica
description: A small keyboard you blow into, combining a clear key layout with expressive breath control.

name: Concertina
description: Compact bellows and buttons bring lively traditional tunes to a highly portable instrument.

name: Flute
description: An airy, agile voice with a bright upper range. Learning to shape the breath is the first step.

name: Clarinet
description: A versatile single-reed voice, warm in the low range and clear in the high notes.

name: Alto Saxophone
description: A rich, expressive reed sound for memorable melodies and improvisation.

name: Tenor Saxophone
description: A bigger saxophone with a warm, husky lower voice and plenty of expressive range.

name: Soprano Recorder
description: A simple, affordable wind instrument with a clear tone and an easy first note.

name: Alto Recorder
description: A warmer recorder voice with a lower range, well suited to solo and ensemble music.

name: Tin Whistle
description: Six finger holes and a bright tone make traditional melodies easy to begin exploring.

name: Harmonica
description: Pocket-sized expression, from simple melodies to bent blues notes. Choose a key to start.

name: Oboe
description: A focused double-reed voice with a distinctive singing tone and demanding breath control.

name: Bassoon
description: A deep, characterful double-reed instrument for orchestral lines and playful melodies.

name: Ocarina
description: A small vessel flute with a rounded tone, well suited to simple melodies.

name: Pan Flute
description: A row of tuned pipes produces soft, breathy melodies as you move between notes.

name: Trumpet
description: A brilliant, bold sound that shines in melodies and fanfares. Lip control develops over time.

name: Trombone
description: A warm brass voice with a moving slide for smooth glides and precise pitch control.

name: French Horn
description: A rounded, noble tone with a wide range. Careful listening and embouchure control are essential.

name: Euphonium
description: A mellow low-brass voice that sings beautifully in lyrical melodies and ensembles.

name: Tuba
description: Deep, rounded bass notes form the foundation of brass groups and orchestras.

name: Cornet
description: A compact brass instrument with a softer, rounder voice than a trumpet.

name: Acoustic Drum Kit
description: Build coordination and drive a band with kick, snare, toms, and cymbals. Needs practice space.

name: Electronic Drum Kit
description: Explore drum-kit rhythms through headphones, though pads and pedals still make impact noise.

name: Cajón
description: Sit on this wooden box and create bass and snare-like sounds with your hands.

name: Djembe
description: A hand drum with deep bass and bright slaps, inviting expressive rhythm and group playing.

name: Bongos
description: Two small hand drums for crisp, conversational rhythms and playful accompaniment.

name: Congas
description: Tall hand drums with rich open tones for layered grooves and rhythmic interplay.

name: Handpan
description: A resonant steel instrument with a fixed set of notes for flowing, melodic rhythms.

name: Kalimba
description: Pluck metal tines with your thumbs for delicate, bell-like melodies and quiet practice.

name: Marimba
description: Warm wooden bars and resonators offer a wide melodic range for mallet players.

name: Glockenspiel
description: Bright metal bars make a sparkling sound and a clear introduction to melodic percussion.

name: Frame Drum
description: A lightweight circular hand drum for exploring pulse, texture, and traditional rhythms.
